newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nine Frenchmen held over Dutch tourist gang rape.
newsitem.headline: Nine Frenchmen held over Dutch tourist gang rape.

text.p: Nine youths were detained in western France on Tuesday in connection with the gang-rape of a 20-year-old Dutch tourist at the weekend, police said.
The youths were to be handed over to a state prosecutor in the town of La Roche-sur-Yon later in the day.
Police initially detained 13 youths after the unidentified woman was raped in a car park outside a night club near the Atlantic resort of Les-Sables-d'Olonne. Four were later released.
